description_en: Upgrades specified plug-ins in a specified database
description_zh: 该接口用于升级目标数据库下的指定插件
kebab_example: aliyun rds update-postgres-extensions --db-instance-id pgm-gc7f10000 --extensions citext --db-names test_db --region cn-hangzhou
name: UpdatePostgresExtensions

parameters.help_en: The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request and prevent duplicate requests. You can generate the value of this parameter on the client side. The value must be unique across different requests and can contain a maximum of 64 ASCII characters. The value cannot contain non-ASCII characters
parameters.help_zh: 用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。由客户端生成该参数值，要保证在不同请求间唯一，最大值不超过64个ASCII字符，且该参数值中不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: Instance ID of the instance. You can call the DescribeDBInstances operation to query instance ID
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en: The names of the plug-ins. Separate multiple plug-in names with commas (,)
parameters.help_zh: 插件名称，多个插件间使用英文逗号（,）分隔

parameters.help_en: The name of the database in the instance. You can call the DescribeDatabases operation to query the name
